title: spenso
description: The complete spenso software family: spenso, spenso-macros, spenso-hep-lib, and spynso3. It provides fast and flexible tensor networks, automatic abstract-index matching, and tensor contraction for high-energy physics.
notes: Spenso-authored source is available under the MIT License.
